You will work in the warehouse, where you will be responsible for picking and collecting orders, driving a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, and preparing orders for shipment. You will also help keep the warehouse clean and organized.

There is a good atmosphere within the company and fun activities are often organized, such as an annual family day. During your break you can enjoy free coffee, tea or soup.
